Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Sulochana Amavasya
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The laconic, energetic, bright-eyed, unblinking owner of the Ecdysis Club.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Mrs E.
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: The self-styled Mother of Monsters. A cheery, tubby woman in a green-grey garment like a baggy dirndl.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Marinette, 'Our Lady of Wires'
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: It reeks of rotten blood, and it clacks its jaw each time it speaks. Perhaps there is a woman, huddled beneath the cloth and the bones. Perhaps it's some puppeteer's trick.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Frau Schlüssel is en route
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: Teresa Galmier's 'correspondent', Sulochana's 'sister', the holder of the Key of Days, is on her way here from Vienna. Perhaps I should meet her at the station.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Frau Schlüssel
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: A spry,forceful woman in severe black and white, tightly wrinkled. She is never observed to blink. A tiny black puppy peeps from her skirts.

Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: 'Miss Naenia'
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: A painting of a dark-skinned woman with snow-coloured eyes and close-cropped ivory-coloured hair. She stands before a small marble tomb overgrown with star jasmine. The painting is signed 'Jonas B. Munch, 1811'.
